mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and consumer spending (measured by RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1% in 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), supply chain bottlenecks are alleviated, boosting corporate margins and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months signals strong labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by >50k in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) below 560,000 million dollars signals reduced household consumption, which lowers corporate revenue expectations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS falls < 560000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% indicate a tightening monetary policy cycle amid rising inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), labor market tightness leads to wage inflation and higher corporate costs, which pressures margins and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
